how: Every runnable model was fitted on every dataset, five-fold cross-validated, including the models the instrument rules out. Regret is how far a choice landed below the best model that ran.
ranked_by: the per-model prior fitted on the earlier 40-dataset run, which had already seen 40 of these datasets

not_runnable.EN5: CatBoost is not installed here; it would need its own build
not_runnable.NN3: a convolutional network needs images, which a CSV cannot hold
not_runnable.NN10: a Siamese network needs pairs, not rows
not_runnable.PR3: a hidden Markov model needs sequences
not_runnable.PR4: a Bayesian network needs a specified graph structure
not_runnable.PR5: a conditional random field needs sequences
not_runnable.GR1: a graph neural network needs a graph
not_runnable.GR2: a graph convolutional network needs a graph
not_runnable.GR3: a graph attention network needs a graph
not_runnable.NLP3: GPT-style models need a text corpus
not_runnable.DR5: an autoencoder is trained on unlabelled data, not scored on a target

prior_knn.label: learned, weighted toward datasets like yours
learned, weighted toward datasets like yours

tuning: the defaults and 9 random configurations, chosen by cross-validation inside each training fold

drift.how: Drift of a known kind was injected into real datasets from PMLB and every checker was asked whether it saw it: a reference window of 500 rows against a current window of 250, each dataset cut 5 ways at random.

scenarios.shift: one feature moves by 0.3 standard deviations
scenarios.scale: one feature's spread widens by half
scenarios.correlation: one feature's link to the others is broken, each feature unchanged on its own
scenarios.selection: rows are drawn more often the higher one feature is
scenarios.label_shift: the most common class is drawn half as often
scenarios.concept: features unchanged, but 30% of labels change in half the space

drift.score: net: the share of the six kinds of drift caught, on average, minus the false alarm rate

DR-M13.how: scipy.stats.anderson_ksamp on each feature, Bonferroni at 0.05

DR-M3.how: counts in the PSI bins, scipy.stats.chi2_contingency, Bonferroni at 0.05

DR-M12.how: on each feature, Bonferroni at 0.05; ties handled, and p by permutation on features with few values (cvm_pvalue())

DR-M14.how: energy distance on standardised features, 200 permutations, 0.05

DR-CV1.how: gradient boosting, five-fold AUC, alarm above 0.6

DR-M10.how: RBF kernel on standardised features, median-distance bandwidth, 200 permutations, 0.05

DR-M7.how: scipy.stats.f_oneway on each feature, Bonferroni at 0.05

DR-M6.how: in reference standard deviations, largest over features; the card sets thresholds in each feature's own units, which cannot be done for many datasets at once, so it is calibrated like DR-M4

DR-M1.how: scipy.stats.ks_2samp on each feature, Bonferroni at 0.05

DR-M4.how: PSI bins, KL(reference || current), largest over features; the card says to calibrate the threshold on a stable period, so it is the 95th percentile of the same number between random parts of the reference

DR-MV1.how: the distance between window means under the reference covariance, as a chi-square with one degree per feature, 0.05

DR-M2.how: deciles of the reference (or its values, when it has few), alarm above 0.25 on any feature

DR-M8.how: gradient boosting's error rate on the current window, alarm at 20% above the reference window's

DR-C2.how: river EDDM, defaults, on the error stream

DR-C1.how: river DDM, defaults, on the error stream

DR-MV2.how: PCA keeping 90% of the variance, fitted on half the reference and calibrated on the other half's 95th percentile; one-sided binomial test at 0.05

DR-C4.how: river ADWIN, defaults, on the error stream

DR-C6.how: river HDDM_A, defaults, on the error stream

DR-M5.how: PSI bins, the divergence in base 2 (scipy returns its square root), alarm above 0.1 on any feature

DR-C9.how: river FHDDM, defaults, on the stream of correct predictions (see streaming())

DR-C7.how: river HDDM_W, defaults, on the error stream

DR-C3.how: river PageHinkley, defaults, on the error stream

DR-C5.how: river KSWIN, defaults (seed 0), on the error stream

not_measured.DR-M9: not a checker on its own: every test above turns its statistic into a p-value, corrected for the number of features as this card says it must be
not_measured.DR-M11: no implementation among the benchmark's dependencies (Alibi Detect has one)
not_measured.DR-C8: river, which supplies the other streaming detectors, does not ship it
not_measured.DR-DL1: made for images and audio (A35, A36), and needs a network trained per window; the benchmark is tables
not_measured.DR-DL2: made for images and audio (A35, A36), and needs a network trained per window; the benchmark is tables

dirty_5.description: 5% of numeric cells replaced by text junk

labels_10.description: 10% of training labels replaced by another row's

missing_10.description: 10% of feature cells missing, at random

missing_30.description: 30% of feature cells missing, at random

messy.how: 20 classification and 20 regression benchmark datasets, damaged on purpose and run again with every model: cells blanked at random, junk text in numeric columns, and training labels swapped for other rows' labels. Every model is scored on the true labels, and compared with its own score on the same dataset clean.
